newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Acacia patient with Helix stake.
newsitem.headline: Acacia patient with Helix stake.

text.p: Acacia Resources Ltd said on Wednesday it was taking a long-term view on its 19.9 percent stake in Gawler Craton explorer Helix Resources Ltd.

Managing director Michael Folie told reporters after the annual meeting he would not comment on whether it would be easier to mop up the rest of the company which has seen a dramatic drop in its share price since Acacia moved in.
"We are interested not in the company (but) in the particular deposit they have got," he said.
"It is very prospective and they just need the time to be able to prove it up and we have got the patience to go with it, it is not really about just buying and selling shares," he said.
